page.overview:
Who is Eye of the Storm?

Eyvindr, better know to his cyclops followers as the Eye of the Storm, is a storm giant who is posing as an ancient cyclops avatar of the Stormlord, gathering battalions of followers to carry out revenge on the Council of Seven Scepters.

According to legend, an ancient cyclops gave her only eye in exchange for the power of the storm, becoming the first stormcaller, and came to be known as the Eye of the Storm. It is said that anywhere there is a storm, she can observe the elements as if it were through her own eyes.

In truth, the Eye of the Storm is a vengeful storm giant named Eyvindr, who is posing as a demigod and intent on raising an army to exact retribution on the Council of Seven Scepters. His plan is to conceal his true identity until he believes that his control over the stormcallers is absolute.

Between 812 and 836 PD, a secretive group of stormcallers were active in the Daggerbay Mountains, where they gathered in an old elven temple called the Skyneedle and conducted communal rituals to connect with the entity, who incrementally increased their power.
